article.headline: Barkley puts up 16, Grand Canyon defeats Cal Poly 99-71
article.description: — Blake Barkley's 16 points helped Grand Canyon defeat Cal Poly 99-71 on Wednesday.

article.story: PHOENIX -- — Blake Barkley's 16 points helped Grand Canyon defeat Cal Poly 99-71 on Wednesday. Barkley also had five rebounds for the Antelopes (3-0). Tre Holloman scored 13 points and added six assists. Jaden Zimmerman shot 4 of 6 from the field to finish with 13 points. Hamad Mousa led the Mustangs (1-2) in scoring, finishing with 16 points. Cal Poly also got 13 points and six rebounds from Troy Plumtree. Jess Esso Essis finished with 10 points. Grand Canyon led Cal Poly 37-29 at the half, with Barkley (nine points) its highest scorer before the break. Grand Canyon outscored Cal Poly in the second half by 20 points, with Holloman scoring a team-high 11 points in the final half. Up next Up next for Grand Canyon is a Saturday matchup with UL Monroe at home, and Cal Poly visits Idaho on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
